capability.summary: Vision-Language Models (VLMs) hold promise for zero-shot video task-progress estimation in robot learning, yet existing frameworks frequently suffer from confirmation bias, hallucinating progress in failed executions due to implicit success assumptions or relative temporal ranking designs. capability.title: D&A: Decoupling Description and Assessment Enables VLMs as Zero-Shot Robotic Reward Models

capability.title: WebHarbor: Docking Real Websites for Evolving GUI Agent Environments

capability.title: NitiBench+: A Temporal Thai Legal Question Answering Benchmark Across 17 Domains

compute.summary: Most parameters of a Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) model belong to its experts, and standard training keeps every expert gradient in GPU memory until the optimizer step. This memory grows with the number and size of the experts, so it rises as MoE models scale. compute.title: Sonar-MoE: In-Backward Expert Updates for Memory-Efficient Mixture-of-Experts Training

capital.summary: Robust 3D point-cloud recognition is critical for robotics, mapping, and urban sensing, yet point-cloud classifiers often suffer performance drops under domain shifts caused by sensor changes, environmental variation, and acquisition artifacts. capital.title: 3D-BBDA: Backpropagation-Free Black-Box Domain Adaptation for Robust 3D Point Cloud Recognition

embodiment.summary: Pre-touch sensing, or sensing information about an object before contact, is an attractive modality for robot hands as it can allow a robot to anticipate and respond to a contact before it happens. embodiment.title: Exploring Proximity and Tactile Sensing for Robotic Manipulation

embodiment.summary: Conventional robot arms can be extremely heavy compared with the everyday objects they manipulate, creating a significant inertia mismatch at contact. embodiment.title: When Robots Outweigh Objects: How Inertia Mismatch Shapes Robot Policy Learning

embodiment.title: Pixel: A Co-Designed Full-Stack Robot System for Learning General-Purpose Mobile Manipulation

embodiment.title: Mediating Human-Swarm Interactions Through a Robot Helper: A Shepherding-Inspired Approach

Existing approaches typically address either crowd avoidance or semantic path planning in isolation. embodiment.title: Pixel-UMI: Learning Environment-Aware Whole-Body Manipulation from Sensorized Human Demonstrations

embodiment.title: PanoTac: A Dense Three-Axis Tactile Sensor for Robust Touch-Centric Manipulation
